description: This file contains extension methods for working with type conversion, especially related to generic types and grain types in Orleans. It provides utilities to determine if a type is generic, get arity, deconstruct and construct generic types, and handle grain type arguments.

classes.name: TypeConverterExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for type conversion and manipulation related to Orleans grain types and generic types.

methods.name: IsGenericType
methods.description: Checks if the provided type string represents a generic type by looking for the '`' character.

methods.name: GetGenericTypeArity
methods.description: Parses the arity (number of generic parameters) from a type string.

methods.name: IsConstructed
methods.description: Determines if a type string represents a constructed generic type by checking for the '[' character.

methods.name: GetDeconstructed
methods.description: Returns the base type name of a generic type by removing its arguments.

methods.name: GetConstructed
methods.description: Constructs a generic type string from an unconstructed type and type arguments.

methods.name: GetConstructed
methods.description: Constructs a grain type using a generic grain type and a generic grain interface type.

methods.name: GetArguments
methods.description: Extracts the type arguments from a constructed generic type string.
